prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Kavita V., Kavita didi, Abhijit bhai, Venkat bhai.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 6:30 pm and 7:27 pm: 13 messages
- between 7:27 pm and 7:44 pm: 3 messages
- between 7:44 pm and 8:30 pm: 11 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "6:32 pm", "sender": "Kavita V.", "text": "Aap sab log ghar pahunch gaye kya?"},
  {"time": "6:35 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Haan main abhi ghar pahuncha hoon."},
  {"time": "6:38 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Main bhi raste mein hoon, thodi der mein pahunch jaunga."},
  {"time": "6:42 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Abhijit bhai, woh puraane kharche ka hisaab dekh liya aapne?"},
  {"time": "6:47 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Haan Kavita didi, maine saara hisaab milakar dekh liya hai."},
  {"time": "6:51 pm", "sender": "Kavita V.", "text": "Kuch baaki toh nahi reh gaya na kisi ka?"},
  {"time": "6:55 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Mera woh thoda sa balance bacha hua tha."},
  {"time": "7:02 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Haan Venkat bhai, maine aapka baaki hisaab chukta kar diya hai."},
  {"time": "7:08 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Achha thik hai, main check karke batata hoon."},
  {"time": "7:14 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Chai peene ka plan kab ban raha hai phir?"},
  {"time": "7:18 pm", "sender": "Kavita V.", "text": "Haan bohot din ho gaye sabhi ko mile hue."},
  {"time": "7:22 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Shaam ko milte hain market ke paas wale cafe mein."},
  {"time": "7:25 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Haan woh jagah sahi rahegi."},
  {"time": "7:29 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Mujhe bhi wahan ka khana bohot pasand hai."},
  {"time": "7:35 pm", "sender": "Kavita V.", "text": "Venkat bhai aapko aapka hisaab mil gaya na?"},
  {"time": "7:41 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Haan mujhe mil gaya hai, sab clear hai ab."},
  {"time": "7:46 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Sahi hai, chalo saara hisaab-kitaab khatam hua."},
  {"time": "7:50 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Aap log kitne baje tak aao ge?"},
  {"time": "7:54 pm", "sender": "Kavita V.", "text": "Main samay par wahan aa jaungi."},
  {"time": "7:59 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Main bhi usi waqt tak pahunch jaunga."},
  {"time": "8:04 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Main bhi thoda jaldi nikalne ki koshish karunga."},
  {"time": "8:09 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Sabhi log time par aana bas."},
  {"time": "8:13 pm", "sender": "Kavita V.", "text": "Haan bilkul, late mat hona koi."},
  {"time": "8:18 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Wahan chal kar purane kisse bhi yaad karenge."},
  {"time": "8:22 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Bohot maza aane wala hai."},
  {"time": "8:26 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Thik hai phir wahan milte hain."},
  {"time": "8:29 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Haan sabhi log dhyan se aana."}
]
